approximations.description: The file states model glasses by nd and vd only. Each is modelled as a three-term Sellmeier solved through the vacuum C, d and F lines with the stated Abbe number and a normal-glass partial dispersion of 0.60; the d-line index is exact.

evidence_notes: The file states 13 surfaces in 4 elements and 0 aperture stop(s); the import reproduces that decomposition.
The collection's summary sheet states no first-order value for this input, so no source comparison is claimed.

The sources sit on the lens axis 100 mm before the first vertex and emit along it. The design diverges at an infinite conjugate (EFL -52.552 mm, BFL -72.571 mm), so the rear focus is virtual and the observation stays at the file's own image distance, 45.448500 mm from the first vertex.
